parrafo_1.es: AceLocksmith es una cerrajería móvil con sede en Lakeland. El equipo de Mark atiende cierres de autos, casas y negocios, programa llaves y controles, repara y cambia cerraduras, e instala cerraduras inteligentes, con una camioneta totalmente equipada que llega directo a tu puerta.
parrafo_1.en: AceLocksmith is a mobile locksmith based in Lakeland. Mark's team handles car, home and business lockouts, programs keys and fobs, repairs and rekeys locks, and installs smart locks, working out of a fully stocked van that comes straight to you.

parrafo_2.es: Reseña tras reseña dice lo mismo: llegan rápido, explican el problema con claridad y cobran precios razonables. Tahnee Mitchell programó una llave de auto nueva en 30 minutos después de que su mamá perdiera la suya, y Thomas Hillman los describe como quienes le salvaron el día en una emergencia real.
parrafo_2.en: Review after review says the same thing: they show up fast, explain the problem clearly and charge a fair price. Tahnee Mitchell had a new car key programmed in 30 minutes after her mom lost hers, and Thomas Hillman describes them as the team that saved his day during a real emergency.

items.quote: Excellent customer service!! I was in an emergency situation and the team from Ace Locksmith saved the day, literally! They have excellent communication, they were available immediately, they made me feel safe and they certainly turned what could have been a stressful night around.

If you want quick and efficient locksmith for your car, this is the company to use. My mom lost her keys, they programmed my car key in 30 minutes. Price is very reasonable and affordable. They are 24 hours so they are always available. Very nice and great customer service. Wish I could give them more than 5 stars.
Very impressed with their work, quick and fast. Mark knows what he's doing.
